Daily Quiz.question: ১) Ezra Pound is widely known as -
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ezra Pound, in full Ezra Loomis Pound হচ্ছেন একজন American poet and critic.
- তিনি একজন discerning and energetic entrepreneur of the arts who did more than any other single figure to advance a “modern” movement in English and American literature.
- Ezra Pound, English Literature এ exponents of Imagism বা  'Imagism' এর প্রবক্তা হিসাবে সুপরিচিত।
- Imagist Poetry এর উদাহরণ হিসাবে তিনি দুই লাইনের একটি কবিতা লিখেছিলেন, যার নাম In a Station of the Metro.
কবিতাটি - 
'The apparition of these faces in the crowed
Petals on a wet, black though.'

Some of Ezra Pounds major writings are - 
- Umbra: Collected Poems
- Literary Essays
- Make it New
- Guide to Kulchur
- Homage to Sextus Properties
- Ripostes
- The Cantos
- Lustra
- Personae
- The Pisan Cantos 
- Trachinian Women, etc.

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) The novel 'Ulysses' is written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
The novel 'Ulysses' is written by Irish writer - James Joyce.

- ১৯২২ সালে এটি প্রথম প্রকাশিত হয়। 
-  Stylistically dense and exhilarating,  এটি সাধারণত English Literature এ একটি masterpiece হিসাবে বিবেচিত হয় এবং it has been the subject of numerous volumes of commentary and analysis.
- The novel is constructed as a modern parallel to Homer’s Odyssey.
- একটি single day এর মধ্যে Dubline এর আশেপাশে ঘটা কাহিনী নিয়ে এই উপন্যাসটি লেখা।
-  The three central characters - Stephen Dedalus Leopold Bloom, a Jewish advertising canvasser; and his wife, Molly—are intended to be modern counterparts of Telemachus, Ulysses (Odysseus), and Penelope, respectively, and the events of the novel loosely parallel the major events in Odysseus’s journey home after the Trojan War.

উল্লেখ্য যে, Ulyssess নামে Victorian poet Alfred Tennyson এর একটি poem রয়েছে।

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) 'Death of a Salesman' is a play written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• 'Death of a Salesman' is a play written by - Arthur Miller.
- Arthur Miller, in full Arthur Asher Miller একজন American playwright, who combined social awareness with a searching concern for his characters’ inner lives.
- ১৯৪9 সালে লেখা 'Death of a Salesman' এর জন্য তিনি সাহিত্য জগতে বিশেষ ভাবে পরিচিত।
- তিনি তাঁর এই সাহিত্যকর্মের জন্য Pulitzer Prize লাভ করেন।
- এই play টিতে তিনি একজন salesman এর tragedy এর গল্প বলে গেছেন who gave his life, or sold it” in pursuit of the American Dream.

এই play এর উল্লেখযোগ্য চরিত্র সমূহ - 
- Willy Loman
- Biff Loman
- Linda Loman
- Happy Loman
- Charley
- Bernard
- Ben
- The Woman.

Source: Britannica

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who wrote the novel 'Sons and Lovers'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• D.H Lawrance wrote the novel 'Sons and Lovers'.

- ১৯১৩ সালে প্রকাশিত এটি D.H Lawrence এর semi-autobiographical novel.
- এই novel টিকে Lawrence এর প্রথম mature novel ও বলা হয়।
-  It is a psychological study of the familial and love relationships of a working-class English family.

এই novel এর কেন্দ্রীয় চরিত্র সমূহ - 
- Paul Morel
- mother, Gertrude
- Miriam Leivers,
- Clara Dawes

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) 'The Metamorphosis' by Franz Kafka is a/an -
Daily Quiz.exp:
The Metamorphosis, symbolic story by Austrian writer Franz Kafka.
- এটি ১৯১৫ সালে সর্বপ্রথম German language এ Die Verwandlung নামে প্রকাশিত হয়।
- The opening sentence of The Metamorphosis has become one of the most famous in Western literature: “As Gregor Samsa awoke one morning from uneasy dreams, he found himself transformed in his bed into a gigantic insect.”

• Franz Kafka was a novelist, short story writer and an exixtentialist.
তাঁর উল্লেখ্য সাহিত্য কর্ম - 
- The Metamorphosis
- The Trial
- The Castle
- Amerika

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) 'Eric Arthur Blair' is the real name of -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• 'Eric Arthur Blair' was the real name of - George Orwell.
- George Orwell, Modern Period এর একজন সুপরিচিত লেখক।
- তিনি একাধারে English novelist, essayist, and critic.
- তিনি তাঁর 'Animal Farm'  এবং  Nineteen Eighty-four নামক novel এর জন্য বিশেষভাবে পরিচিত।

• George Orwell's Notable Works - 
- A Clergyman’s Daughter
- A Hanging
- Animal Farm
- Burmese Days
- Coming Up for Air
- Down and Out in Paris and London
- Homage to Catalonia
- Keep the Aspidistra Flying
- Nineteen Eighty-four
- Shooting an Elephant
- Such, Such Were the Joys
- The Lion and the Unicorn
- The Road to Wigan Pier, etc.

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) 'The Proposed Roads to Freedom' is Written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• 'The Proposed Roads to Freedom' is Written by - Bertrand Russell.
- Bertrand Russell, in full Bertrand Arthur William Russell, is a British philosopher, logician, and social reformer, founding figure in the analytic movement in Anglo-American philosophy.
- This book contains Russell's astute political commentary on anarchism, socialism, and syndicalism.

Russell's Some notable works - 
- Mysticism and Logic.
- History of Modern Philosophy
- The Analysis of Mind
- Authority and the Individual.

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Which of the following is the first novel of Ernest Hemingway?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) The Old Man and The Sea
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) For Whom the Bell Tolls
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ernest Hemingway, in full Ernest Miller Hemingway is an American novelist and short-story writer.
- The Sun Also Rises তার প্রথম novel যা Novelist হিসেবে ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে তাকে প্রতিষ্ঠিত হতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করেছে।
- published in 1926, titled Fiesta in England, the novel captures the moods, feelings, and attitudes of a hard-drinking, fast-living group of disillusioned expatriates in postwar France and Spain.

এই novel এর উল্লেখযোগ্য চরিত্র সমূহ - 
- Jake Barnes
- Lady Brett Ashley
- Robert Cohn
- Bill Gorton
- Mike Campbell
- Pedro Romero
- Montoya
- Frances Clyne

• Hemingway was noted both for the intense masculinity of his writing and for his adventurous and widely publicized life.
- তাঁর সংক্ষিপ্ত এবং সুস্পষ্ট গদ্যশৈলী ২0 শতকে American and British কথাসাহিত্যে একটি শক্তিশালী প্রভাব ফেলেছিল।
তার বিখ্যাত novel সমূহ - 
- The Sun Also Rises,
- The old man and The Sea
- A Farewell to Arms,
- Green Hills of Africa ইত্যাদি

Source: An ABC of English Literature by Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Edgar Allan Poe is a/an ______ short story writer.
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Edgar Allan Poe, American short-story writer, poet, critic, and editor who is famous for his cultivation of mystery and the macabre.
- তাঁর “The Murders in the Rue Morgue” আধুনিক গোয়েন্দা গল্পের সূচনা করেছিল এবং  the atmosphere in his tales of horror is unrivaled in American fiction.
- His “The Raven” (1845) numbers among the best-known poems in the national literature.

তাঁর উল্লেখযোগ্য সাহিত্যকর্ম সমূহ -

- Eureka
- Lenore
- Ligeia

- Morella

- The Black Cat
- The Cask of Amontillado
- The Fall of the House of Usher
- The Masque of the Red Death
- The Murders in the Rue Morgue
- The Mystery of Marie Roget

- The Premature Burial

- The Valley of Unrest

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) Which of the following statements is not true about Jean Paul Sartre?
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He was one of the exponents of the philosophy of existentialism.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He was an American novelist
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He refused the Nobel prize
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) He was a French Philosopher.
Daily Quiz.exp:
• He was an American novelist, Jean Paul Sartre সম্পর্কে এই statement টি ভুল কারণ তিনি একজন French Philosopher ছিলেন।
- Jean Paul Sartre French philosopher, novelist, and playwright, best known as the leading exponent of existentialism in the 20th century.
- তিনি ১৯৬৪ সালে তাঁর autobiography, Words (1963) এর জন্য Nobel Prize লাভ করেন।
- কিন্তু  Sartre famously declined the prize, claiming that a writer must “refuse to let himself be transformed into an institution.

Sartre's some notable works - 
- Nausea
- Bring and Nothingness: An Essay on Phenomenological Ontology
- No Exit
- The Roads to Freedom

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) 'Salt-Water Ballads' is a poem by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• 'Salt-Water Ballads' is a poem by - John Masefield.
- John Masefield is a poet, best known for his poems of the Salt-Water Ballads and
- His long narrative poems, such as The Everlasting Mercy. (1911), shocked literary orthodoxy with its phrases of a colloquial coarseness hitherto unknown in 20th-century English verse.

His notable works -
- Dauber
- Reynard the Fox
- Salt-Water Ballads
- The Everlasting Mercy
- The MidNight Folk

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who is the author of the famous 'Harry Potter' series?
Daily Quiz.exp:
• J.K. Rowling, in full Joanne Kathleen Rowling, pen name of Joanne Rowling, is a British author, creator of the popular and critically acclaimed Harry Potter series.
- Harry Potter was first introduced in the novel Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone (1997; also published as Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone),
- Harry Potter series এ মোট ৭টি খন্ড রয়েছে যা সারাবিশ্বে অত্যধিক জনপ্রিয়। 
Harry Potter books - 
- Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone
- Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
- Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
- Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
- Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
- Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
- Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) 'The God of Small Things' is a book written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
'The God of Small Things' is a book written by - Arundhati Roy an Indian author, actress, and political activist.
- 'The God of Small Things' Arundhati Roy এর একটি award winning novel.
- 1960 সালে Kerella, Indiaতে বসবাস কারী একটি পরিবারের কাহিনীর মাধ্যমে সামাজিক নানান চিত্র অথা caste- discrimination কে তুলে ধরেছেন লেখিকা।
- ১৯৯৭ সালে এটি প্রকাশিত হয়। 
- এই novel এর জন্য Arudhati Roy, Booker Prize লাভ করেন।

এই Novel এর উল্লেখযোগ্য চরিত্র সমূহ - 
- Ammu 
- Baba
- Estha 
- Rahel
- Valutha, etc.

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) 'Brave New World' is a novel by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Brave New World is a novel written by Aldous Huxley.
- এটি ১৯৩২ সালে প্রকাশিত হয়। 
- The book presents a nightmarish vision of a future society.
- এটি মূলত একটি scientific novel.
- Brave New World is set in 2540 CE, which the novel identifies as the year AF 632.

• Aldous Huxley, in full Aldous Leonard Huxley, English novelist and critic gifted with an acute and far-ranging intelligence whose works are notable for their wit and pessimistic satire.
- He remains best known for one novel, Brave New World (1932), a model for much dystopian science fiction that followed.

Aldous Huxley's some other notable works - 
- After Many a Summer Dies the Swan
- Antic Hay
- Crome Yellow
- Eyeless in Gaza
- Point Counter Point
- The Devils of Loudun
- The Doors of Perception
- Those Barren Leaves, etc.

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) 'Adella Quested, Dr. Aziz and Mrs. Moore are some important Characters form the novel -
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) A Room with a View
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) Where angels Fear to Tread
Daily Quiz.exp:
Adella Quested, Dr. Aziz and Mrs. Moore are some important Characters form the novel - A Passage to India.

'A Passage to India' is written by - E.M. Forster.
- Edward Morgan Forster Modern Period 4 QPG¶ famous novelist, essayist, social and literary critic.
- His 'A Passage to India' was published in 1924 and considered one of the author's finest works.
এই novel টিতে মূলত racism and colonialism ফুটে উঠেছে।
The book portrays the relationship between the British and the Indians in India.

এই Novel এর কিছু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ চরিত্র হচ্ছে -
- Dr. Aziz
- Mrs. Moore
- Adela Quested
- Rony Hislop
- Cyril Fielding

E.M. Forster's other works -
- Aspects of novel
- The Longest Journey
- A Room with a View
তবে উল্লেখ্য যে, 'A Passage to India' শিরোনামে Walt Whitman এর একটি poem রয়েছে।

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' is written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• One Hundred Years of Solitude is a novel written by Gabriel García Márquez.

- এটি সর্বপ্রথম ১৯৬৭ সালে Spanish Language এ Cien años de soledad নামে প্রকাশিত হয়।
- It was considered the author’s masterpiece and the foremost example of his style of magic realism.
- This is the author’s epic tale of seven generations of the Buendía family that also spans a hundred years of turbulent Latin American history, from the postcolonial 1820s to the 1920s.

Gabriel Garcia Marquiz's some other notable works - 
- Love in the Time of Cholera
- Memories of My Melancholy Whores
- News of a Kidnapping
- No One Writes to the Colonel
- One Hundred Years of Solitude
- The Leaf Storm ইত্যাদি।

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) 'Things Fall Apart' is famous novel by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
- Things Fall Apart, first novel by Chinua Achebe, written in English and published in 1958.
- Things Fall Apart helped create the Nigerian literary renaissance of the 1960s.
- The novel chronicles the life of Okonkwo, the leader of an Igbo community, from the events leading up to his banishment from the community for accidentally killing a clansman, through the seven years of his exile, to his return, and it addresses a particular problem of emergent Africa—the intrusion in the 1890s of white missionaries and colonial government into tribal Igbo society. 

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Which of the following literary works doesn't belong to George Bernard Shaw?
Daily Quiz.exp:
প্রশ্নে উল্লেখিত অপশন গুলোর মধ্যে - A Farewell to Arms' is written by - Ernest Hemingway.
- এটি ১৯২৯ সালে প্রকাশিত তাঁর তৃতীয় novel.
- A Farewell to Arms is particularly notable for its autobiographical elements.
- এই novel এ arms বলতে একই সাথে অস্ত্র এবং প্রেমিকার হাত বোঝানো হয়েছে।

অন্যদিকে, 
Arms and The Man, Man and Superman, You Never can Tell হচ্ছে George Barnerd Shaw এর famous plays. 
- তাঁর উল্লেখযোগ্য সাহিত্য কর্ম গুলো - 
- Candida
- Arms and the Man
- You Never Can tell 
- Man and Superman
- Major Barbara
- The Apple Cart
- Pygmalion, etc.

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) Alexandre Dumas was a/an _____ writer.
Daily Quiz.exp:
• Alexandre Dumas is one of the most prolific and most popular French authors of the 19th century.
- Without ever attaining indisputable literary merit, Dumas succeeded in gaining a great reputation first as a dramatist and then as a historical novelist.
-His is memoirs, which, with a mixture of candour, mendacity, and boastfulness, recount the events of his extraordinary life, also provide a unique insight into French literary life during the Romantic period.

Some Notable works of Alexandre Dumas - 
- The Count of Monte Cristo
- The Count of Monte Cristo
- The Three Musketeers

Source: Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) 'Wings of Fire' is an autobiography written by -
Daily Quiz.exp:
• 'Wings of Fire' is an autobiography written by - A.P.J Abdul Kalam.
- He was Indian scientist and politician who played a leading role in the development of India’s missile and nuclear weapons programs.
- He was president of India from 2002 to 2007.

- There are 25 books written by A.P.J Abdul Kalam. These includes - 
- Wings of Fire
- Ignited Minds
- Turning Points
- The Luminous Sparks
- Indomitable Spirit
- Spirit of India.

Source: Britannica.
